Fresh producer compiler spills2.22KiB, previously1.95KiB; L1 cache pressure influence remains~100percent.
Allocated source storage does not prove physical savings; old bounds aliases knots.
Bit parity is to guarded candidate reference; integrated reference errors are not all<=1e-5.
